title: nf-core/seqsubmit pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the sample sheet provided with params.input if params.mode is set to 'metagenomic_assemblies'

id.description: A unique identifier for this data entry. Must be globally unique within the input dataset
id.errorMessage: ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fasta.errorMessage: FASTA file must be provided and have extension '.fa.gz', '.fasta.gz', '.fna.gz'
fasta.description: Path to assembly contigs in FASTA format compressed with gzip

fastq_1.errorMessage: FASTQ file must have extension '.fq' or '.fastq' (optionally gzipped)
fastq_1.description: Path to single-end/paired-end forward reads in FASTQ format (optionally gzipped). Required if coverage is not provided. For co-assemblies, semicolon-separated paths (e.g. run1_R1.fq.gz;run2_R1.fq.gz)

fastq_2.errorMessage: FASTQ file for reverse reads must have extension '.fq' or '.fastq' (optionally gzipped)
fastq_2.description: Path to reverse reads in FASTQ format for paired-end data (optionally gzipped). Leave empty for single-end reads. For co-assemblies, use semicolon-separated paths (e.g. run1_R2.fq.gz;run2_R2.fq.gz)

coverage.errorMessage: Coverage must be a positive number or empty
coverage.description: Estimated sequencing depth of the assembly (optional). If this value is missing, it is computed automatically during pipeline execution when reads are provided

run_accession.errorMessage: Accession must be provided and cannot contain spaces
run_accession.description: ENA run accession(s) for the reads used to generate the metagenomic assembly. Reads must already be submitted to ENA. For co-assemblies, use semicolon-separated values (e.g. ERR000001;ERR000002)

assembler.errorMessage: Assembler must be provided and cannot contain spaces
assembler.description: Name of the assembler software used to generate the assembly, e.g. MEGAHIT, SPAdes, metaSPAdes, Flye, etc

assembler_version.errorMessage: Assembler version must be provided and cannot contain spaces
assembler_version.description: Version of the assembler software used to generate the assembly, e.g. 1.0.0

errorMessage.anyOf: Either reads or coverage must be provided in the sample sheet for each assembly
